note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a NOR 7, 8; A06b NOR 7, 8; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 8 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Norway, 2024
sources.said: Person has resided in Norway for a total of 8 years in the last 11 years with residence or work permits of at least 1 year duration, or, if person has sufficient income (established by  regulation) according to a tax settlement, for a total of 6 years in the last 10 years with residence or work permits of at least 1 year duration. ... n.a. ... n.a.
